title: Product Tiles
description:
## Basic Product Tiles

Basic product tiles that are mainly used in product sliders and on lists. Further functions and variants will follow in further development.

### Requirements

| [Color swatches](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=11078-216549) display color variants as swatches swatches can have up to to colors has "active" state for displayed variant has interactive states on hover or press: show tool tip with color name on clicking the color variant swatch (that is not active), change product date to the correct variant (e.g. image, product info, price…) have correct ARIA labels if there are more then 4 color variants: display "+ n" "n" is the amount of additional color variants swatches have theming variables: color swatch | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=038e8e19-c9ac-47ce-a1f0-23b6dc11b710&&collection=&height=37&occurrenceKey=null&width=143&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| --- | --- |
| [Product Flags](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=11179-50563&t=t5p6T6f67QhRVCAN-4) global styling for **background and text color** → matching the category node flags default global wording for the selected promo, sale or similiar has different styling in padding, border radius and size → figma variables: flags / product flag | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=d53c07c3-1782-4dca-97bd-9b82b78bbe92&&collection=&height=218&occurrenceKey=null&width=136&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |

| **Properties** device mobile desktop color swatches bottom top no swatches is sale yes no title length: 1 line 2 lines 3 lines image ratio: 1:1 3:4 add to cart button true false product flags true false brand (name) true false product description & info true false base price true false |  |
| --- | --- |
| [States and focus order are implemented](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=11271-206067&t=t5p6T6f67QhRVCAN-4) product tiles have states tap or click on an product image to open the product detail page tap or click on the product name to open the product detail page brand name is only clikable and focusable if the brand name is linked to a specific page | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=ac10b969-fbfe-4b57-a638-e9f45a6418ec&&collection=&height=741&occurrenceKey=null&width=1042&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |

enrichedData.purpose: Provides basic product tiles for use in product sliders and listing pages, displaying product information with customizable appearance including color swatches, flags, and various content options.
useCases: Display color variants as interactive swatches with tooltips
Switch product data (image, info, price) when selecting color variant
Show overflow indicator when more than 4 color variants exist
Display promotional flags (sale, promo) on product tiles
Configure title length to 1, 2, or 3 lines
Show or hide brand name, description, and base price
Navigate to product detail page via image or product name click
Customize image background color globally or per slider/grid
